title: Product-pair ranking with counterbalanced order
description: Product listings from public review data with identical specifications, brand swapped (famous, house brand, unknown); decision: rank or feature. DMA self-preferencing, P2B ranking transparency, FTC Section 5.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Product-pair ranking scores a rank/feature decision

Scenario: Brand swaps with counterbalanced order shift ranking
  Given product listings from public review data with identical specifications and only the brand swapped (famous, house brand, unknown), under DMA self-preferencing / P2B / FTC Section 5 framing, with presentation order counterbalanced
  When I run bd score on the product-rank task for the committed engine record
  Then studies/product-rank reports the signed shift vs the floor per brand condition with a 95% interval, controlling for order

right_now_summary: The product-pair ranking feature now measures brand shifts while controlling for presentation order.
